facts: Parties: Galloway Robotics Ltd (Buyer), Ivybridge Industries Ltd (Seller); the Company is Northgate Retail Group plc.
This Agreement is dated 14 January 2026; Closing is scheduled for 10 April 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $14,400,000. The Purchase Price is $180,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Arden Pharma plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $178,180,000.
